subject: Partner (IB) system, and the looping hero video
body:
Partners:
- Every account gets a referral code; /r/CODE remembers who sent a visitor
  for 30 days and signup records the attribution even when the referrer is
  not an approved partner yet. An unknown code is ignored, not an error.
- Partner dashboard at /partner: link, referral list, commission history,
  payout requests. Referrals are shown coarsely - a partner sees that
  someone joined, not another customer's email.
- Back office gets Partners and Payout requests: approve, revoke, credit a
  commission, and decide a payout.

The money rule, which is the whole point:
  available = earned - paid - requested
Earned counts rows in `commissions` and nothing else. On a sibling brand,
payout receipts and profit-share were added into the same total and
affiliates were told they were owed money that had already been sent. Here
payouts only ever subtract, a request subtracts while it waits so the same
balance cannot be claimed twice, the balance is re-read under a row lock
inside the transaction, and only a request still in 'requested' can be
decided - so a double submit cannot pay twice.

payout_requests.decided_by has no cascade, like admin_actions.admin_id: an
account that has approved a payment cannot be deleted.

Hero video:
- The Grok clip is 15s and does not loop; its last frame against its first
  measures 16.5dB. Crossfading the tail back onto the head takes that to
  28.7dB, which is compression noise rather than a visible jump. Encoded to
  4.3MB from 15.6MB, audio stripped.
